leadText: Kiyomi Asai (Japanese: 浅井清己 Asai Kiyomi) is a Japanese voice actress for .
plainText:
Kiyomi Asai (Japanese: 浅井清己 Asai Kiyomi) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Asai was born on April 12, 1974 in , . Asai began her work in during the final episode of , voicing one of her most significant roles as Matori. She has also voiced various Pokémon during . Throughout her career, Asai has also been credited under a number of aliases, including Don Ohana (Japanese: 大花どん Ohana Don), Kiyosato Otomo (Japanese: 大友清里 Otomo Kiyosato), Yuria Hokuto (Japanese: ほくとゆりあ Hokuto Yuria), Shinya Aizaki (Japanese: 愛咲深夜 Aizaki Shinya), Remi Haruno (Japanese: 春野レミ Haruno Remi), and Midori Amamiya (Japanese: 雨宮みどり Amamiya Midori). Asai is currently affiliated with D-Color.
